components.css: .ds-entry{color:var(--paper,#e9dcd5);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#4c3c42);font-family:var(--font,"Comfortaa","Trebuchet MS",sans-serif);}.ds-entry summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 24px;gap:23px;align-items:center;min-height:110px;padding:21px 12px 21px 10px;list-style:none;cursor:pointer;border-radius:5px;transition:background-color 200ms ease}.ds-entry summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-entry summary:hover{background:#b77c8e09}.ds-title{display:block;font-size:28px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.2;transition:color 200ms ease;font-family:var(--hand,"Caveat","Comfortaa",cursive);}.ds-teaser{display:block;margin-top:7px;color:var(--muted,#b8a9a9);font-size:11px;line-height:1.7}.ds-date{color:var(--muted,#b8a9a9);font-size:11px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}.ds-entry svg{width:19px;height:19px;color:var(--muted,#b8a9a9);transition:transform 240ms ease,color 240ms ease;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}.ds-entry[open] svg{transform:rotate(180deg);color:var(--pink,#d7a0af)}.ds-entry[open] .ds-title,.ds-entry summary:hover .ds-title{color:var(--pink,#d7a0af)}.ds-entry summary:focus-visible{outline:2px dashed var(--pink,#d7a0af);outline-offset:7px;border-radius:4px}.ds-entry p{padding:0 29px 20px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.9;color:#d0bfc2}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-entry summary,.ds-title,.ds-entry svg{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
Warm charcoal paper, dusty rose marks, imperfect pencil outlines and a tiny sea voyage make a personal archive feel intimate and curious. The avatar reference supplies the palette and handmade character. Romance stays restrained, with room for lightly humorous observations.

This is a record of the first implemented prototype, not a user-approved final identity. The title, copy, chapter treatments and descriptive language remain provisional. Values were extracted from source; rendered desktop/mobile screenshots and computed styles could not be verified because the local server/browser failed with EPERM.
keyCharacteristics: Dark paper with a subtle grain.
Handwritten headings beside quiet rounded body text.
Open rows threaded together by an imperfect dashed line.
dos: Do preserve the dark, minimal, hand-drawn character established by the avatar.
Do keep text, focus and disclosure affordances legible against the textured canvas.
Do treat chapter-specific colors and content as provisional, with room for later identities.
donts: Don't replace the quiet outline world with realistic, glossy or three-dimensional imagery.
Don't turn the passive locked rows into misleading controls.
Don't use sentimental clichés or visual motifs that reveal the story's planned surprises.
